purpose: Teach: 親しく/ノック/バレンタイン/小児科/丸ごと/ひととき/救っ/かなわ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、最近、お前と、親しくなれて、嬉しいよ、私、本当に。
lines.en: Riku — I'm really glad we've gotten closer lately. I mean it.
lines.style: Soft opening, like she's been holding this and finally said it. Sincere underneath the awkwardness. Quiet, steady eye contact. Slight tremor of vulnerability at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。職員室のドア、ノックして、入るのって、緊張するよな、いつも。
lines.en: Yeah. Knocking on the staff room door and going in — that always makes me nervous, you know?
lines.style: Deflection masked as wry observation. He's avoiding the emotional weight of what she just said. Light tone but there's a nervous undercurrent. Quick, almost dismissive pacing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今年のバレンタイン、リク、誰かに、貰ったって、聞いたよ、本当?
lines.en: Is it true you got chocolate from someone on Valentine's Day this year?
lines.style: Deliberate, probing tone — she's testing whether he'll actually answer. Not accusatory, but curious with an edge. Leans in slightly. Watching his reaction.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 弟、最近、熱出してさ、小児科、連れていく、お母さん、大変だぜ。
lines.en: My little brother's had a fever lately, and it's been rough getting him to the pediatrician. Mom's been worn out.
lines.style: Sudden topic shift, almost abrupt. Genuine concern underneath. Quieter than before — he's thinking about something that worries him. Reflective, distracted quality. Deflecting again.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お弁当のおにぎり、丸ごと、ぼく、食べちゃった、リク、ごめん、お腹空いて。
lines.en: I ate the whole onigiri from your lunch by accident — I was starving, sorry about that.
lines.style: Self-deprecating, light confession. Doesn't quite meet his eyes. Fast delivery, trying to slide past it with humor. Awkward energy masked by wryness.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 部活前、皆で、ひととき、休憩するの、結構、好きだぜ、俺。
lines.en: I really like those moments before club when everyone takes a breather together. Just that small bit of peace.
lines.style: Warm, genuine. The first genuinely comfortable thing he's said in this exchange. Slower pace, more grounded. Like he's letting his guard down slightly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、犬を、救ったことあるって、本当?優しいんだね、リク、知らなかった。
lines.en: Is it true you saved a dog once? I didn't know you were that kind, Riku.
lines.style: Animated surprise — she's delighted by this new information about him. Genuine admiration breaking through. Bright, almost playful. Like she's seeing something in him she didn't expect.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のスポーツの実力には、俺、かなわないよ、桜、本当に、すごいぜ。
lines.en: Your athletic ability is something I can't come close to, Sakura. You're really incredible.
lines.style: Direct praise, delivered quietly but with conviction. Vulnerable — he's laying something honest down. Slower, deliberate pacing. Eye contact that holds. No deflection this time.
